SELECT r.id AS "id", r.material_code AS "materialCode", r.material_name AS "materialName", r.qty AS "qty", r.receive_date AS "receiveDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = r.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", r.unit_price AS "unitPrice", r.supply_amount AS "supplyAmount", r.vat_amount AS "vatAmount", r.total_amount AS "totalAmount", COALESCE(COALESCE((SELECT ci.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item ci JOIN tb_common_code_group cg ON cg.common_code_group_id = ci.group_id AND cg.group_code = 'TAX_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant ct ON ct.tenant_id = cg.tenant_id AND ct.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE ci.item_code = r.tax_type LIMIT 1), r.tax_type), '과세') AS "taxType", r.barcode AS "barcode", COALESCE(r.is_return, 0) AS "isReturn", r.return_reason AS "returnReason", r.return_of_id AS "returnOfId", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(r2.qty)), 0) FROM material_receiving r2 WHERE r2.return_of_id = r.id) AS "returnedQty" FROM material_receiving r
r.receive_date = #{date} AND r.receive_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = r.client_code LIMIT 1) ILIKE '%' || #{clientQ} || '%' AND r.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialQ} || '%' AND COALESCE(r.is_return, 0) = 1 AND COALESCE(r.is_return, 0) = 0
ORDER BY r.receive_date DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT name FROM materials WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT warehouse_cd FROM tb_warehouse WHERE factory_code = 'F001' AND plant_code = 'P001' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND default_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_seq, warehouse_id LIMIT 1
SELECT client_code FROM clients WHERE name = #{name} AND client_code IS NOT NULL AND client_code != '' ORDER BY client_code LIMIT 1

SELECT i.item_code FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'TAX_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_nm = #{name} ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.use_at = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, i.sort_order, i.item_code LIMIT 1
SELECT qty AS "qty", material_name AS "materialName" FROM material_receiving WHERE id = #{id} AND is_return = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(qty)), 0) FROM material_receiving WHERE return_of_id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_receiving WHERE material_code = #{code} AND receive_date = #{date}
mapper.update: UPDATE materials SET stock_qty = COALESCE(stock_qty, 0) + #{qty} WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT material_code AS "materialCode", qty AS "qty" FROM material_receiving WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT unit_price FROM material_receiving WHERE material_code = #{code} AND client_code = (SELECT c.client_code FROM clients c WHERE c.name = #{clientName} AND NULLIF(c.client_code, '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.client_code LIMIT 1) AND unit_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT material_code AS "materialCode", material_name AS "materialName", SUM(qty) AS "totalQty", COUNT(*) AS "entryCount" FROM material_receiving WHERE receive_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = material_receiving.client_code LIMIT 1) ILIKE '%' || #{clientQ} || '%' AND material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialQ} || '%' GROUP BY material_code, material_name ORDER BY material_name

SELECT receive_date AS "date", material_name AS "materialName", qty AS "qty", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = material_receiving.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName" FROM material_receiving WHERE material_code = #{code} AND receive_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = material_receiving.client_code LIMIT 1) ILIKE '%' || #{clientQ} || '%' ORDER BY receive_date, id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_used), 0) FROM production_material_usage WHERE material_code = #{code} AND SUBSTRING(created_at, 1, 10) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
